input.title: Use PUBLIC_URL env var instead of localhost in password reset email links
input.body:
File: src/notifications/templates.ts

The password reset email currently hardcodes `http://localhost:3000` as the `BASE_URL` when `process.env.PUBLIC_URL` is not set. This causes the reset link to point to `localhost`, which is unreachable for users outside the development environment. The fix is to rely entirely on `process.env.PUBLIC_URL` for production deployments, ensuring the link uses the correct domain (e.g., the deployed application's URL). This matches the intended behavior for all environments and resolves the issue described in the report.

This causes the reset link to point to `localhost`, which is unreachable for users outside the development environment. The fix is to rely entirely on `process.env.PUBLIC_URL` for production deployments, ensuring the link uses the correct domain (e.g., the deployed application's URL). This matches the intended behavior for all environments and resolves the issue described in the report.
